_doc: gen_bars.py FE pins: per geometric key the undercut profile bar_fe.tune solved (A) and everything gen_bars reads from it (frequencies, ratios, err_c, torsion ratios, strike weights at the 17 points, V1 nodes, mass, h_min, curvature), recorded where the approved tables were made. The profile has more free parameters than tuning targets, so the exactly tuned profiles form a family and least_squares stops on a different member (~1 um apart) on another BLAS / CPU: the strike weights then move and so do the header words. tests/py/test_gen_bars.py recomputes every field from the pinned A and checks that each profile is a solution of the tuning (exact to 1e-5 cent, or the penalised optimum). fingerprint: the FE inputs (stale = --repin). Regenerate only on purpose: tools/gen_bars.py --repin.
